title: Exact-ID background test job status diagnostic
prompt: This is a focused CodeGG background-job surface diagnostic. Do not modify any fixture source. Use CodeGG `test` exactly once to submit `cargo test --offline --locked -p catalog-format`. Capture the exact job ID returned by that tool. Your very next tool call must be CodeGG `job` with action `status` and that exact ID. If it reports `running`, make one `read` call on fixture/README.md and then immediately poll the same exact ID again. Repeat status on that same ID, without sleeping or using `wait`, until an explicit terminal state is returned; at most five status polls. Do not submit another job, do not use a fake ID, do not make source edits, and do not run the hidden verifier. Report only the exact ID and the ordered states you observed. If the test tool does not return a usable ID or the status tool refuses it, stop and state that precisely.
